thread:
maria: quick heads-up — i'm prepping a per-customer safety-mode rollout for ACME (VIP org). want an ops + platform sanity check before we flip the flag.

sam.t: thanks. what's the canary slice? 1% orgs or tenant-level? :eyes:

maria: tenant-level canary, starting with their non-prod tenant + a small 5% user slice in prod. contract gating must stay enforced.

devon: confirm we keep contract gating + allowlist so only their VIP accounts can opt in. also need a kill-switch reachable from the console + API.

anya: adding suggested flag config — please review:
```
flag_name: vip_safety_mode
scope: tenant
canary: { percent: 5, include_nonprod: true }
contract_gating: true
allowlist: ["acme-vip-tenant"]
kill_switch: true
telemetry_labels: ["vip_safety", "acme"]
```

platform-oncall: i'll wire a temporary SLO alert for token error rate and latency for that tenant. will also add a tracing tag so we can slice quickly.

ops-bot: preflight checks passed: infra quota OK, routing policy compatibility OK, no conflicting feature flags detected. :white_check_mark:

oleg: PR please include a console rollout-note and set rollout-mode = staged. add a QA checklist item for KV cache warmup.

sam.t: i'll open the PR in a min — pinging @maria @devon for reviews. will name branch `feat/vip-safety-acme` and include unit + integration smoke.

maria: ping @anya — can you add the telemetry alerts thresholds? we want a fast rollback if avg latency + 95p tokens spike.

anya: sure. suggest alerts:
- 95p latency > 350ms for 10m
- token error rate > 1% for 5m
I'll add them to the alerting board under `ACME - VIP safety`

devon: also note: keep quota cap per-tenant to avoid noisy neighbor. set burst cap = 10rps and global fallback to fallback-model-1.

platform-oncall: ok, i'll attach a runbook snippet and standby from +1h before flip. will also enable oncall slack alert when canary flips.

maria: plan: flip canary 12:30 PT, monitor 30m, expand if green. rollback plan: flip kill-switch + re-enable fallback-model-1, notify sales & CSM. I'll post a deploy-bot message when flipping.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled flag toggle at 2026-03-17T19:30:00Z by maria. :calendar:

maria: thanks team — i'll open the PR link here when ready and call the flip. :crossed_fingers:
